title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England request for approval and review by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy of 365 day firm natural gas transportation agreement for use at a cogeneration facility to be constructed by Bay State Paper Company.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms or the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-12)
